name: Why does my kitchen remodeling quote keep changing?

mainEntity.name: Why does my kitchen remodeling quote keep changing?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can request a fixed project price only when the scope, drawings, selections, allowances, and responsibility for unknown conditions are defined clearly. A “fixed” number can still change through owner selections, concealed damage, requested revisions, or exclusions. Context: Kitchen estimates are especially sensitive to appliances, cabinetry, countertop fabrication, utility relocation, permits, and finish changes. Key factors: - What is included and excluded. - Whether allowances reflect actual selections. - The written change-order process. Practical guidance: Ask for a line-item proposal, allowance schedule, payment milestones, start assumptions, and procedures for approving additions or credits. Compare proposals by total scope, not headline price. Soft positioning: Elite Remodeling & Design can develop a coordinated scope that links design decisions with construction pricing and sequencing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Quotes change when selections, allowances, layout, permits, concealed conditions, or exclusions are not settled. Request a line-item scope, allowance schedule, design revision rules, and written change-order process. A clearer design and construction plan makes later price changes easier to understand and control.
